dogecoin.text: If approved, GDOG would be the first Dogecoin ETF listed in the US, joining Grayscale's popular bitcoin and ether products.

The Greyscale Dogecoin Trust is to be renamed the Greyscale Dogecoin Trust ETF, according to the filing. The business stated that the shares would likely be listed on NYSE Arca with the ticker symbol "GDOG." The action depends on the SEC approving the fund's registration as well.

According to a registration statement submitted to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Greyscale Investments has applied to turn its Dogecoin trust into an exchange-traded fund and is requesting regulatory approval to float on NYSE Arca with the symbol GDOG.
